code.description: The service item code, when it came from a service request.

ActionItemEntry.description: Something to bring or restock, e.g. 2 × Bath towel.

ActionPriority.description: How urgently the work should be done.

ActionStatus.description: Where a human action is, canonically.

ActionType.description: The kind of physical work (spec §7 minimum action types).

triggerText.description: The triggering message's text, if it had any.

retrieved.description:
Every authoritative source the agent had, read as context or returned by its tools, each at the
            version read (spec §27).

oneOf.description: How the agent's replies were checked against the sources, for grounded answers.

usage.description: Tokens used across every model call.

AITraceBody.description: The full account of an AI turn (spec §26); each list is in the order things happened.

next.description: Pass as `after` to read the next page; `null` on the last page.

AITracePage.description: A page of traces, newest first.

oneOf.description: The property the turn concerned, if any.

agent.description: The agent that ran it, e.g. `concierge.answer`.

causationId.description: The event or message that directly caused it, if any.

triggerType.description: What kind of thing triggered it, e.g. `GuestMessage`.

triggerId.description: The message or event that triggered it, if it has an ID.

intent.description: What the agent understood was being asked for, if it decided.

flowEvents.description:
The events recorded in the same flow, oldest first (at most
            int AITraceResponse.MaxFlowEvents), including the trace's own `AITraceCreated`.

redacted.description: Whether anything was withheld or masked for this reader.

AITraceResponse.description: One AI turn as its reader may see it (spec §26): what the reader's role may not see is withheld or masked.

oneOf.description: The property the turn concerned, if any.

triggerType.description: What kind of thing triggered it.

triggerId.description: The message or event that triggered it, if it has an ID.

intent.description: What the agent understood was being asked for, if it decided.

AITraceSummary.description: One AI turn in a list.

oneOf.description: Where it is, if recorded.

version.description: Increases with every change; send it back in `If-Match` to update safely.

AuditClassification.description:
How much of an invocation its audit record may keep (spec §11 `auditClassification`). Every invocation is
audited (spec §35); the classification decides only the detail recorded.

AuthorizationDecision.description: The authorization and policy decision on a capability call.

allowedCallers.description: The callers allowed, at least one, each once.

CapabilityAuthorization.description:
Who may invoke a capability (spec §11 `authorization`). Callers not listed are refused. Tenant and property
isolation apply on top of this, whoever the caller is (P10).

purpose.description: Read as context, or called by the model as a tool.

capability.description:
The capability and version that ran, e.g. `Property.GetOperatingHours@1`; for a tool not on
            the allow-list, the tool name the model used.

callId.description: The model's tool call ID, for tool calls.

oneOf.description: The capability's audit classification, when it exists.
The input sent; `null` when withheld.
The output returned, when it succeeded; `null` when withheld.

invocationId.description: The capability invocation, when it succeeded.

errorCode.description: Why it failed, or `null` when it succeeded.

withheld.description: Whether the input and output were withheld from this reader (sensitive capabilities).

CapabilityCall.description: One capability call in an AI turn: what ran, whether it was allowed, and what it returned.

CapabilityCaller.description:
Who may invoke a capability (spec §11 `authorization`). Staff callers are distinguished by role
(Admin, Manager, Worker; plan §3), so a definition can, for example, let workers complete tasks but only
administrators change configuration.

CapabilityCallPurpose.description: Why a capability call in a trace ran.

version.description: The version, from 1; a breaking change to input or output adds a new version.

description.description: What it does and when to use it; AI agents read this to choose tools.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the input object.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema of the output object.

confirmationPolicy.description: Whether it runs only after explicit confirmation.

sideEffects.description: The most far-reaching effect it can have.

idempotency.description: How a repeated invocation is kept from repeating its effect.

auditClassification.description: How much of an invocation its audit record keeps.

CapabilityDescription.description:
A registered capability as `/api/v1/capabilities` publishes it: every spec §11 field, with the input and
output as JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) in the wire format.

note.description: The worker's note, e.g. `Left at the door`.

ConfirmationPolicy.description:
Whether a capability runs only after the person it acts for explicitly confirms it (spec §11
`confirmationPolicy`). Confirmation is asked for only where policy requires it (spec §35).

ConnectorKind.description: The external systems a property connects to (spec §10).

provider.description: The chosen provider, e.g. `Mock`; null when not configured.

healthy.description: Whether its last check passed; null when it is not checked (not configured or disabled).

problem.description: What the check found, when it failed.

availableProviders.description: The providers this deployment has for the connector.

ConnectorResponse.description: One of a property's connectors: which provider serves it and whether it is healthy. Settings are never shown.

ConnectorStatus.description: Whether a property uses one of its connectors.

type.description: What kind of text it is.

title.description: Title, or the question for an FAQ.

body.description: The text, or the answer for an FAQ.

oneOf.description: The subject it describes; `null` for the property in general.

status.description: Where it is in its lifecycle.

version.description: Increases with every change; send it back in `If-Match` to update safely.

ContentItemResponse.description: A content item, normalized (trimmed; tags lower-cased and sorted).

ContentStatus.description: Where a content item is in its lifecycle. Only published content reaches guests and the concierge.

propertyId.description: The property the guest is talking to.

oneOf.description: The guest's stay, if linked.

ConversationResponse.description: A guest's conversation with the property.

oneOf.description: Broad grouping; required.

CreateAmenityRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/amenities`: adds a facility guests can use, e.g. the pool (Journey 2). Its hours and rules are
        separate operating hours and policy records about it.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

oneOf.description: What kind of text it is; required.

title.description: Title, or the question for an FAQ; required.

body.description: The text, or the answer for an FAQ; required.

oneOf.description: The subject it describes; omit for the property in general.

CreateContentItemRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/content`: drafts descriptive text (overview, FAQ, directions, announcement) that the concierge
        searches once published. Rules belong in policies, not content.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

description.description: When or what it is, e.g. `Served 5:30-10pm`.

CreateMenuRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/menus`: adds a menu to a restaurant (Journeys 3 and 7). The menu belongs to the restaurant's
        property.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

oneOf.description: Whose hours: the property, or one of its spaces, amenities, restaurants, or services; required.

CreateOperatingHoursRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/operating-hours`: sets when something is open (Journey 2): weekly hours, date overrides, and
        temporary closures. A subject has at most one operating hours record; change it with `PUT`.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

CreateOrganizationRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/organizations`: creates an organization in the caller's tenant.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

oneOf.description: What the policy governs; required.

title.description: Short title, e.g. `Gym age policy`; required.

content.description: The authoritative text the concierge answers from; required.

effectiveFrom.description: First property-local date it applies; omit for immediately.

effectiveTo.description: Last date it applies (inclusive); omit for no end.

oneOf.description: The space, amenity, restaurant, or service it governs; omit for property-wide.

CreatePolicyRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/policies`: drafts an authoritative rule of the property (Journey 4), kept apart from descriptive
        content. It answers guests once activated.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

title.description: Display title, e.g. `Jazz on the Terrace`; required.

oneOf.description: The kind of event; required.
Who it is for; everyone when omitted.

localStart.description:
Start in property-local time, written without an offset, e.g. `2026-11-01T19:00:00`;
            required.

localEnd.description: End in property-local time, after the start and at most 14 days later; required.

oneOf.description: Price per person; omit when free or not published.

bookingRequired.description:
Whether guests must book; the concierge then explains how, never implying a booking was
            made. Not required when omitted.

CreatePropertyEventRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/events`: schedules something happening at the property, e.g. live music (Journey 8). Guests are
        offered it until it ends.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. `Europe/London`; required. Local times such as hours use it.

oneOf.description: Street address; required.

CreatePropertyRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/properties`: creates a property (one hotel) for an organization in the caller's tenant (Journey 1).
        Missing or invalid fields are all reported at once.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

CreateRestaurantRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/restaurants`: adds a place to eat or drink (Journey 3). Its menus are separate menu records, and
        its opening hours an operating hours record about it.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

code.description: Stable machine code, unique within the property, e.g. `housekeeping.amenities`; required.

oneOf.description: Which kind of team fulfils it; required.

isGuestRequestable.description: Whether guests may request it through the concierge; yes when omitted.

targetCompletion.description:
Target time from request to completion, e.g. `00:30:00`, at most 7 days; used for
            staff deadlines, never quoted to guests.

CreateServiceRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/services`: defines something the property does for guests, e.g. delivering towels or fixing the
        air conditioning. Guest service requests name a service and, optionally, one of its items.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

oneOf.description: What kind of place it is; required.

CreateSpaceRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/spaces`: adds a place to a property's hierarchy, e.g. Main Building → Floor 4 → Room 412.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

isOnDuty.description: Whether they start on duty; off duty when omitted.

CreateStaffMemberRequest.description: Adds someone to a property's roster. Missing values are reported by the server, not the deserializer.

id.description: The persona's key, e.g. `guest-alex`; send it to have a token issued.

description.description: Who they are, e.g. the in-house guest in room 412.

role.description: Their role: `Guest`, or a staff role (`Worker`, `Manager`, `Admin`).

DevPersona.description: Someone from the Aurora Grand seed a local developer can sign in as.

DevTokenResponse.description: A bearer token for a dev persona, valid only against this API while dev tokens are on.

DietaryTag.description: A dietary property of a menu item.

key.description: Its evidence key, `{work}/{file}`, to send in ValueList<string>? CompleteWorkRequest.Evidence.

EvidenceResponse.description: A file uploaded as evidence for work, to complete it with.

reason.description: Why it cannot be done, e.g. `Could not access the room`; required.

aggregateType.description: The kind of record that raised it.

FlowEvent.description: An event recorded in a trace's flow.

replies.description: Each reply's verdict, in order; a rejected reply may be followed by a corrected one.

GroundingCheck.description: How a grounded answer's replies were checked.

clientMessageId.description: The client's own ID for a guest's message, if it sent one.

itemName.description: The item, e.g. `Bath towel`, for a service with items.

description.description: The request in the guest's words, for a service without items.

location.description: Where it is delivered or done, e.g. `Room 412`.

localRequestedAt.description: When it was requested, in the property's time.

GuestRequestResponse.description: One of a guest's unresolved requests, as the guest sees it: what, where, and where it is, but not who is doing it.

GuestRequestStatus.description: Where a guest's request is, as the platform knows it; never an estimate of when it will be done.

to.description: Last closed date, on or after From; required.

HoursClosure.description:
Closed on every date from From to To, whatever the weekly hours or overrides
say, e.g. for maintenance.

date.description: The property-local date; required, at most once per schedule.

HoursOverride.description: Hours that replace the weekly hours on one date, e.g. a holiday.

IdempotencyPolicy.description: How a capability keeps a repeated invocation from repeating its effect (spec §11 `idempotency`, P8).

provider.description: The configured provider; empty when the task has no route.

fallbacks.description: Where it falls back to, as `provider/model`, in order.

InferenceTaskResponse.description: Which model an AI task uses for the tenant (P6).

connectors.description: The property's connectors, one per kind.

inferenceTasks.description: The AI tasks and their models.

IntegrationsResponse.description:
`GET /api/v1/integrations` (spec §34 Integrations): what a property and the platform are connected to, read-only.
        Providers, bindings, and models change through configuration, not this API.

IssueDevTokenRequest.description: Asks for a token for one of the dev personas.

id.description: To keep an item already on the menu, its ID (answers cite it); omit for a new item.

name.description: Display name, e.g. `Wild mushroom risotto`; required.

oneOf.description:
Price; omit when not published, so the concierge says it does not know rather than guessing. All
            prices on a menu use one currency.

isAvailable.description: Whether it can currently be ordered; available when omitted.

MenuItemRequest.description: A dish or drink on a menu being written.

id.description: Stable ID; send it back to keep the item when replacing the menu.

oneOf.description: Price, if published.

isAvailable.description: Whether it can currently be ordered.

MenuItemResponse.description: A menu item, normalized (trimmed; dietary tags sorted, de-duplicated, vegan with vegetarian).

version.description: Increases with every change; send it back in `If-Match` to update safely.

MenuResponse.description: A menu with its items, normalized.

oneOf.description: The prompt version sent, or `null` when the task has none.

failure.description: Why it failed, or `null` when it answered.

ModelAttempt.description: One provider tried for a model call.

attempts.description: Every provider tried, in order; the last one answered unless the call failed.

systemPrompt.description: The rendered instructions sent, or `null` for none.

continuesConversation.description: Whether this call continued the previous call's conversation.

input.description: The messages sent that the previous call's conversation and output did not already include.

structuredOutput.description: Whether the answer had to match a JSON Schema.

oneOf.description: What the model answered, or `null` when no provider could serve the call.
Why a chat model stopped, if it answered.
Tokens used, if it answered.

model.description: The model that answered, as its provider names it.

ModelCall.description:
One model call in an AI turn, with the exact prompt and messages sent and what came back. Messages the model already saw
are not repeated: when ContinuesConversation is `true`, the conversation sent is the previous
call's conversation and output followed by this call's Input.

ModelCallKind.description: What a model call in a trace was.

amount.description: The amount, non-negative, in major units (e.g. 12.50).

Money.description: An amount in one currency. The AI quotes prices only from these canonical values (spec Journey 7).

OpeningInterval.description:
Open from Opens to Closes, property-local. Closing at or before opening means
it ends the next day (`18:00` to `02:00`); `00:00` to `00:00` means all day.

weekly.description: The usual hours per day of the week.

closures.description: Date ranges when it is closed.

version.description: Increases with every change; send it back in `If-Match` to update safely.

OperatingHoursResponse.description:
An operating hours record, normalized: days in week order, intervals by opening time, overrides by date, closures
by start.

version.description: Increases with every change; send it back in `If-Match` to update safely.

OrganizationResponse.description: An organization: a company that owns or operates properties.

oneOf.description: What it governs; `null` for property-wide.

status.description: Where it is in its lifecycle.

version.description: Increases with every change; send it back in `If-Match` to update safely.

PolicyStatus.description: Where a policy is in its lifecycle: Draft, then Active, then Retired. Only active policies answer guests.

scope.description:
Where the binding applies: `Default`, `Operation:{name}`, `Tenant`, or
            `Tenant operation:{name}`.

PortBindingResponse.description: What one of the platform's ports is bound to (P6): its adapter, never its settings.

text.description: The message; required, at most 4000 characters.

clientMessageId.description:
The client's own ID for the message, at most 100 characters: sending the same ID again
            returns the message already recorded instead of recording it twice. Optional, but clients that retry should send it.

PostMessageRequest.description: A guest's message to the property.

type.description: A URI identifying the kind of problem.

code.description: The stable error code, e.g. `persistence.version_mismatch`; act on this, not the title.

errors.description: For invalid fields: the messages per field.

field.description: The field, as named in the request.

message.description: Why it is invalid, for people.

fieldErrors.description: For invalid fields: each field's stable code.

Problem.description: An RFC 9457 problem: what went wrong, and the stable code to act on.

hash.description: The text's SHA-256 (`sha256:` and 64 hex digits).

PromptVersionData.description: The exact prompt text a call used.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. `GB`; required.

oneOf.description: Where, if recorded.
Price per person, if published.

version.description: Increases with every change; send it back in `If-Match` to update safely.

PropertyEventStatus.description: Whether an event is going ahead.

version.description: Increases with every change; send it back in `If-Match` to update safely.

PropertyResponse.description: A property's base information, normalized (trimmed, country code upper-cased).

accepted.description:
Whether it was complete, well formed, and cited only sources the agent had (or said it could not
            answer).

ReplyVerdict.description: Whether one model reply was accepted.

oneOf.description: Where it is, if recorded.

version.description: Increases with every change; send it back in `If-Match` to update safely.

ServiceCategory.description: Which kind of team fulfils a service.

code.description: Stable machine code, unique within the service, e.g. `bath_towel`; required.

maxQuantityPerRequest.description: Most a guest may ask for at once, 1 to 100; required.

ServiceItemRequest.description: Something guests can ask for as part of a service, e.g. a bath towel.

maxQuantityPerRequest.description: Most a guest may ask for at once.

code.description: Machine code, unique within the property.

category.description: Which kind of team fulfils it.

isGuestRequestable.description: Whether guests may request it through the concierge.

targetCompletion.description: Target time from request to completion.

version.description: Increases with every change; send it back in `If-Match` to update safely.

isOnDuty.description: Whether they are on duty; required.

SetDutyRequest.description: Puts a staff member on or off duty.

isAvailable.description: Whether it can be ordered; required.

SetItemAvailabilityRequest.description:
`PUT /api/v1/menus/{id}/items/{itemId}/availability`: marks one item available or sold out, without resending
        the menu.

SideEffect.description: The most far-reaching effect a capability can have (spec §11 `sideEffects`).

type.description: The kind of record, e.g. `Policy` or `OperatingHours`.

version.description: The record's version when it was read; it increases with every change.

SourceReference.description:
The authoritative platform record an answer comes from (P4). Agents cite it, and traces record it, so every
statement can be checked against the record and version it came from; an answer with no source is unknown.

SpaceKind.description: What kind of physical place a space is. Any kind may contain any other.

oneOf.description: The containing space; `null` for a top-level space.

kind.description: What kind of place it is.

version.description: Increases with every change; send it back in `If-Match` to update safely.

StaffMemberResponse.description: A staff member on a property's roster.

oneOf.description: What kind of thing; required.

id.description: Its ID (for SubjectKind.Property, the property's own); required.

SubjectReference.description:
The thing a record is about: whose hours, which amenity a policy governs, what content describes. It must exist in
the same property.

TraceMessage.description: A message sent to or received from a model.

TraceMessageRole.description: Who a message in a trace is from.

text.description: The text, or a tool result's content.

callId.description: The tool call it is or answers.

isError.description: Whether a tool result reports an error.

provider.description: The provider whose reasoning it is.

TracePart.description: One part of a TraceMessage; which fields are set depends on Type.

TracePartType.description: What a part of a message in a trace is.

citations.description: The sources the answer relies on; empty when nothing authoritative answered.

oneOf.description: Broad grouping; required.

UpdateAmenityRequest.description:
`PUT /api/v1/amenities/{id}`: replaces an amenity's information and location; omitting the location clears it.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

oneOf.description: What kind of text it is; required.

title.description: Title, or the question for an FAQ; required.

body.description: The text, or the answer for an FAQ; required.

oneOf.description: The subject it describes; omit for the property in general.

UpdateContentItemRequest.description:
`PUT /api/v1/content/{id}`: replaces a content item's text; its status does not change.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

UpdateMenuRequest.description:
`PUT /api/v1/menus/{id}`: replaces the whole menu. Items sent with their ID keep it; items sent without one are
        new; items left out are removed.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

UpdateOperatingHoursRequest.description: `PUT /api/v1/operating-hours/{id}`: replaces the whole schedule (Journey 16). The subject does not change.

oneOf.description: What the policy governs; required.
What it governs; omit for property-wide.

UpdatePolicyRequest.description:
`PUT /api/v1/policies/{id}`: replaces a draft or active policy's content; a retired policy cannot change.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

oneOf.description: The kind of event; required.
Who it is for; everyone when omitted.

localStart.description: Start in property-local time, written without an offset; required.

oneOf.description: Price per person.

bookingRequired.description: Whether guests must book; not required when omitted.

UpdatePropertyEventRequest.description:
`PUT /api/v1/events/{id}`: replaces a scheduled event's information; a cancelled event cannot change.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

oneOf.description: Street address; required.

UpdatePropertyRequest.description:
`PUT /api/v1/properties/{id}`: replaces a property's base information. The owning organization does not change.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

UpdateRestaurantRequest.description:
`PUT /api/v1/restaurants/{id}`: replaces a restaurant's information; omitting an optional field clears it.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

code.description: Stable machine code, unique within the property; required.

oneOf.description: Which kind of team fulfils it; required.

isGuestRequestable.description: Whether guests may request it through the concierge; yes when omitted.

targetCompletion.description: Target time from request to completion, at most 7 days.

UpdateServiceRequest.description:
`PUT /api/v1/services/{id}`: replaces a service's definition; omitting an optional field clears it.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

oneOf.description: What kind of place it is; required.

UpdateSpaceRequest.description:
`PUT /api/v1/spaces/{id}`: replaces a space's descriptive information. Its property and parent do not change.
        Every field may be omitted: missing required fields are reported by validation, field by field.

UpdateStaffMemberRequest.description: Replaces a staff member's name and skills.

oneOf.description: The day, e.g. `Monday`; required, at most once per schedule.

WeeklyHours.description: The usual hours of one day of the week. A day that is not listed, or has no intervals, is closed.

WorkAction.description:
What the caller may do to a piece of work now, so the surface shows only those buttons (Journey 13: the worker does
not see the orchestration).

instructions.description: What to do, e.g. `Deliver 2 × Bath towel`.

deadline.description: When it must be done by (UTC), if it has a deadline.

oneOf.description: Who holds it, if anyone.

assigneeName.description: Their name, if they are on the roster.

endedAt.description: When it was completed, failed, cancelled, or expired (UTC).

completionNote.description: The worker's note on completing it.

evidence.description: Keys of the files completed with, each readable at `/api/v1/work/{id}/evidence/{key}`.

failureReason.description: Why it failed or was cancelled.

actions.description: What the caller may do to it now.

WorkItemResponse.description: A piece of work as staff read it (spec §32's action card).

WorkView.description:
The staff surface's views of a property's work (spec §32). A worker sees their own work; managers and administrators
see everyone's.

Bearer.description: A staff token or a guest's stay token.
